newPrimaryMechanicsSource.statement: Gems will now be found more regularly when prospecting Midnight ore.
newPrimaryMechanicsSource.supportedConclusion: At least one Midnight prospecting gem-finding rate was increased; exact outputs, coefficients, deployment instant and sample contexts unspecified.
notSupported: No quantitative per-gem P or E

epochPolicy.post: observation UTC start at or after 2026-04-06T00:00:00Z
epochPolicy.quarantine: all intervals intersecting conservative transition window [2026-04-02T00:00:00Z,2026-04-06T00:00:00Z), including crossing cohorts
epochPolicy.caution: Quarantine buffer is a modelling safety assumption around the April 3 dated official entry, NOT a measured deployment window.
epochPolicy.unknown: Invalid or missing timestamps rejected; not assigned to pre or post.

context: observationStart and observationEnd ISO timestamps with timezone
inputContract.events: Each completed cast has distinct castID, zero-inclusive outputCount and refundedInputUnits; aborted cast has neither. No aggregate inventory is silently converted to cast count.
inputContract.outputUniverse: Only marginal output 242608; complete economic output universe remains unverified.

functions.classifyEpoch: Strict Gregorian timestamp parsing with timezone offset and conservative change-point quarantine.
functions.analyzeCohort: Computes observed P=positive completed casts/completed casts and unconditional E=total output including zeros/completed casts; gross, refunded and net inputs separate; observed positive extrema are not hard bounds.
functions.compareEpochs: Requires same exact profession/rank/recipe profile, different source lineage, raw pre and post cohorts; computes descriptive differences only and flags changed patch builds. Does not infer causal hotfix coefficient.

applicability: Research-only, typed fixed context. Hotfix establishes nonstationarity risk, not a measured baseline. Unknown skill, unlock, cast denominator, recipe eligibility or complete output universe blocks numeric transfer and economic use.

uncertainty.sourceTiming: Official dated hotfix note lacks deployment hour; quarantine chosen conservatively.
uncertainty.comparisonConfounding: Patch/build and source-family effects not eliminated by matched profile alone.
uncertainty.noIndependentCohorts: Zero actual source logs ingested; synthetic demonstrations only.
uncertainty.noHardYieldCap: No finite cap asserted from observed positive extrema.

evidenceResearcherRequest: For seven exact stable keys, seek independently dated, post-April-6 zero-inclusive current-Retail completed-cast logs with full rank/skill/spec/gear/unlock/refund and patch/build context; archive April 3 hotfix as a mechanics epoch source without inventing numeric rates.
independentValidatorRequest: Verify official April 3 hotfix date and whether existing source cohorts straddle it. Test timezone/quarantine boundaries, exact context isolation, gross/refund denominators, duplicate study lineages, unknown output universe, and no live EV. Hold out whole independent source families.
blockers: No independent current-Retail cast logs for seven target keys
Official hotfix does not specify magnitude or affected outputs
No independently verified complete output universe, eligibility or minimum skill baseline
